messages.subject: mdtoc integrated review: FAIL
messages.body: Reviewed mdtoc at c9a6f683bb497d975e4bcd76b5163689e4da794d against AC-1..AC-9 with 95 green tests and executable probes; verdict FAIL. AC-2/3/4/5/7/8/9 pass, but AC-1 is violated for CR-only files (second run changes bytes), AC-6 is violated for BOM files (TOC placed before the BOM, which lands mid-file), and U+000B/U+000C/U+0085 split headings when the TOC is inserted; there are also low-severity indent and empty-heading issues. Nothing in the worktree was modified; the fixes (EOL detection incl. CR, BOM handling, splitting lines on CR/LF only) and tests are left for the coordinator.
